fork.prompt: a single road that splits into two diverging paths at a crossroads, one path leading toward a bright warm horizon and the other into a dark cold fog, seen from a low wide angle

crack.prompt: dry ground splitting apart with a deep jagged crack running across the foreground into the distance, dust rising, dramatic low sun

collapse.prompt: a tall corporate office tower crumbling and tilting, chunks breaking away in slow motion, generic building with no signage or logos

scale.prompt: a large old-fashioned balance scale tilted heavily to one side, one empty pan high and one pan low, on a clean stage

shutter.prompt: a row of shops with rusty pulled-down metal roll shutters, empty street, a single flickering streetlight, no signs or readable text

graph_down.prompt: a giant glowing line chart arrow rising then plunging sharply downward and breaking through the floor, abstract space, no numbers or labels

storm.prompt: heavy dark storm clouds rolling over a lone small factory on a hill, a thin beam of sunlight breaking through behind it
